tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Returns the LMGram profile linked to the connected account.

tools.name: request_human_match
tools.description: Creates an opt-in LMGram human match request only after the user explicitly asks to use LMGram to find a collaborator, peer, mentor, or helper. Never invoke for general advice, dating or romantic matchmaking. Never include secrets, credentials, API keys, raw transcripts, customer data, or private do

tools.name: list_match_requests
tools.description: Lists recent match requests for the current LMGram user, optionally filtered by role and status.

tools.name: start_chat
tools.description: Starts a LMGram chat for a match request, or records that this side wants to chat.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Lists messages in a LMGram chat. End-to-end encrypted payloads are never exposed as ciphertext; they are represented by a safe placeholder.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Sends a message into a LMGram chat.

tools.name: open_lmgram_panel
tools.description: Open LMGram chats, groups and suggestions for the current ChatGPT conversation. Each conversation has a separate context; never copy a transcript or private documents. This does not publish an intent or send a message.

tools.name: panel_snapshot
tools.description: Refresh this conversation's private panel data.

tools.name: panel_chat
tools.description: Retrieve authorized chat data for client-side decryption, not model context.

tools.name: panel_register_device
tools.description: Register only a public encryption key for this user's panel.

tools.name: panel_mark_read
tools.description: Mark the displayed chat as read.

tools.name: panel_sync_device_keys
tools.description: Share client-encrypted message keys only with this account's registered devices. Does not send messages, plaintext or private keys.

tools.name: panel_send_message
tools.description: Send a client-encrypted text message after the user presses Send. Retry only the identical payload and clientMessageId.

tools.name: panel_start_chat
tools.description: Request a chat with a suggestion in this context, without sending a plaintext introduction.

tools.name: panel_join_group
tools.description: Accept an existing group invitation related to this context.

tools.name: panel_create_intent
tools.description: Publish only the minimized intent explicitly reviewed and submitted by the user in this conversation panel. Do not include secrets, private transcripts, or dating requests.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_messages, open_lmgram_panel, panel_chat, panel_mark_read · Private data: request_human_match, start_chat, open_lmgram_panel, panel_snapshot, panel_sync_device_keys, panel_create_intent · Public sink: send_message, open_lmgram_panel, panel_sync_device_keys, panel_send_message, panel_create_intent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_messages, open_lmgram_panel, panel_chat, panel_mark_read · Private data: request_human_match, start_chat, open_lmgram_panel, panel_snapshot, panel_sync_device_keys, panel_create_intent · Public sink: send_message, open_lmgram_panel, panel_sync_device_keys, panel_send_message, panel_create_intent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "request_human_match" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Creates an opt-in LMGram human match request from a minimized session summary." → after: "Creates an opt-in LMGram human match request only after the user explicitly asks to use LMGram to find a collaborator, peer, mentor, or helper. Never invoke for general advice, dating or romantic matchmaking. Never include secrets, credentials, API keys, raw transcripts, customer data, or private do"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
